This Criminal Original Petition is filed to call for the records and quash the correspondences dated 03.03.2021 issued by the respondent No.1 to the Banker of the petitioner in C.No. Crime I (3)/963/13101/2020 with reference to CBCID, OCU-I Cr.No.02/2021, under Section 420, 506(i)
IPC & Section 10 r/w Section 24 of Emigration Act; and to provide copy of correspondence dated 09.03.2021 issued by the respondent No.1 to the Sub Registrar Office, Guduvanchery, Chengalpet in C.No. Crime I (3)/963/13101/2020 with reference to CBCID, OCU-I Crime No.02/2021, under Section 420, 506(i) IPC & Section 10 r/w Section 24 of Emigration Act, 1983 to the petitioner; and to annul or nullify the same.
2. All the prayers are with regard to quash the correspondence dated 03.03.2021 by the respondent No.1 to the banker with regard to C.No.Crime I (3)/963/13101/2020 and provide copy of the correspondence dated 09.03.2021 issued by respondent No.1 pertaining to C.No.Crime I (3)/963/13101/2020; and nullify the same and these are only the correspondence made by the first Nandaa Kumar vs State Of Tamil Nadu on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5934642/
2 respondent to the banker as well the Sub https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Registrar,
Guduvanchery.
In pursuance of the correspondence made by the first respondent police, what action had been taken by the concerned authorities not filed.

4. Under these circumstances, challenging the order being the correspondence made by the first respondent to the banker as well the Sub Registrar, Guduvenchery, cannot be entertained and there is no merit in the criminal original petition.
5. Hence, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed, with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the order passed in pursuance of the impugned correspondence made by the first respondent.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
